implementation_summary: Implemented and independently reviewed a bounded policy-aware HTTP fetcher with dial-time public-address enforcement, redirect revalidation, response limits, pacing, retry metadata, and sanitized diagnostics.

files_changed.change: Added the shared safe outbound fetcher, public-address dialer, redirect policy, bounds, pacing, retry metadata, and sanitized result mapping.
Added controlled-server coverage for SSRF, redirects, limits, compression, types, conditional requests, pacing, retry, cancellation, and secret safety.
Extended the accepted fetcher boundary with policy and result metadata needed by ingestion adapters.
Added fixture-backed private, loopback, and link-local rejection proof.

verification.output: Focused fetcher and blocked-target tests passed under the race detector.
Full Go tests and static analysis passed.
